And Another on 7 July, 2025 High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad ?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:106680 Court No. - 75 Case :- Application U/S 528 Bnss No. - 21396 of 2025 Applicant :- Madan Gopal Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Kartikey Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A. Hon'ble Vikas Budhwar,J. 1.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that post inspection in the premises of the applicant on 25.04.2007 at 9:00 in the morning and the allegation that the samples equipment specification and on the basis of the analyst report dated 11.08.2017, a complaint purported to be under Section 17/16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 came to be lodged on 05.11.2007, charges were framed on 05.11.2011, however, the non-bailable warrants have been issued on 17.11.2022. Learned counsel for the applicant makes a limited prayer that the applicant herein submits that due to certain reasons beyond the control and comprehension of the applicant, Madan Gopal vs State Of U.P. And Another on 7 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/137232942/ 1 the applicant could not present himself in drawing the proceedings. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant shall be filing a recall application for recalling of the non-bailable warrants.
